messages.subject: Announce: ICODS abstracts on line
parts:
Hi Distance-sampling list,

I have updated the International Conference on Distance Sampling (ICODS) web
site at

http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/icods/

The site now contains a few photos and a copy of the conference booklet. The
booklet includes abstracts of all the talks, so those of you who could not come
to the conference can get a summary of the proceedings.

Thanks to everyone who came for making the conference such a success. We were
all impressed with the uniformly high quality of the presentations, and the
amount of great work going on in our topic area. Speaking personally, I was
very pleased to have the chance to meet so many of you and find out what you're
up to, and I learnt a lot. Look forward to seeing you all again at some point
in the future.

- Len Thomas

--
Len Thomas (l...@mcs.st-and.ac.uk)

Mathematical Institute, University of St Andrews
Scotland
